name: Keane
source:
The protagonist of this work. He is an early member of the Black Dog Mercenaries and serves as their chief strategist.

He excels at strategy and is ruthless, using any means necessary to achieve his goals. He is also skilled in magic, and his skills surpass those of most magicians.

This time, he receives an order from the leader, Vult, to “create a brothel that symbolizes a nation of service,” and he ends up turning many beautiful women into prostitutes.

[From [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq40/spin.html]official site[/url]]
